notes: Primary experimental paper (Sieverts apparatus, own H2 uptake data on AC, SWCNTs, MWCNTs, GNFs, GO at ~295 K and 77 K up to 7.5 MPa, Figs. 9-12). I4 rests on one value only: a BET area stated as a lower bound (>1900 m2/g) for the commercial AC used, given with its supplier; it is the product's own value and not worded as typical of a kind of material, so treated as met, but it is an inequality and no value is given for the other carbons. No own BET measurement is reported. Not retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction notice in PDF). No statement that the uptake values were published before. Not a review or abstract-only document.
